title: Panasonic EW-DJ40 will not power on
shortDescription: AA cells depleted or installed reversed.
fullDescription: EW-DJ40 cordless flosser uses 2 AA cells. If installed wrong polarity or depleted, the unit will not start. Replace with fresh alkaline.

fixSteps.title: Replace AAs
fixSteps.instruction: Open battery cap, install 2 fresh AAs in the marked direction.

title: EW1411 will not charge on cradle
shortDescription: Cradle pins corroded or adapter failed.
fullDescription: The rechargeable EW1411 / EW1611 sits in an inductive cradle. After splash exposure the contacts can corrode. Wipe pins and confirm 100-240V adapter output.

fixSteps.title: Clean pins
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe cradle pins with alcohol and dry.

fixSteps.title: Test adapter
fixSteps.instruction: Use a known good adapter or measure 5VDC.

title: Pump runs but no water
fullDescription: After refilling the reservoir the pump can air-lock. Hold the unit upright and run for 10-15 seconds with the nozzle in the sink to prime.

fixSteps.title: Prime
fixSteps.instruction: Hold upright, run with nozzle pointed down 15 seconds.

fixSteps.title: Clear inlet
fixSteps.instruction: Empty reservoir, rinse the small inlet screen at the base.

title: Reservoir gasket leak
shortDescription: Tank gasket pinched or out of place.
fullDescription: The reservoir clips onto the body with a rubber gasket. If the gasket lifts during fill, water seeps from the join. Reseat it.

fixSteps.title: Reseat gasket
fixSteps.instruction: Empty tank, lift gasket, set evenly in groove, click reservoir back.

title: Stream weak even on high
fullDescription: Pressure drops as battery depletes. Confirm full charge first. If new battery, descale the nozzle - mineral scale narrows the orifice.

fixSteps.title: Charge or replace cells
fixSteps.instruction: Charge fully or install fresh AAs.

fixSteps.title: Descale nozzle
fixSteps.instruction: Soak nozzle in 50/50 white vinegar 30 min, rinse.

faq.a: Lukewarm only - hot may distort plastic.

title: Motor noticeably louder than new
shortDescription: Pump cavitating from low water level.
fullDescription: Running the unit with reservoir below MIN cavitates the pump - loud and damaging. Always start with reservoir filled to MAX line.

fixSteps.title: Refill
fixSteps.instruction: Top reservoir to MAX before each session.

faq.a: Less than 30 sec - then risk damage.

title: Pressure mode button unresponsive
shortDescription: Button gasket sticky from toothpaste residue.
fullDescription: If toothpaste seeps under the silicone button cover, the dome switch can stick. Wipe and dry to restore.

fixSteps.title: Clean button
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe with damp cloth and let dry overnight.

title: Rechargeable runs less than 5 minutes
fullDescription: After 3-5 years the internal NiMH cells lose capacity. Panasonic does not officially sell battery service; use a battery service shop or replace the unit.

fixSteps.title: Service or replace
fixSteps.instruction: Take to a battery service or buy new unit.

title: Nozzle releases mid-use
fullDescription: The push-in nozzle relies on a small O-ring at its base. When worn, the nozzle pops off under pressure. Replace nozzle and check the receiver O-ring inside the head.

fixSteps.title: Replace nozzle
fixSteps.instruction: Use new nozzle - twist to lock.

title: Water visible inside handle
fullDescription: If water reaches the battery compartment or motor housing, the unit must be retired. Continued use risks shock or fire on rechargeable models.

fixSteps.title: Retire unit
fixSteps.instruction: Stop using and recycle at e-waste.
